name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatMemberSelectorActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server or channel workflow needs users selected from the server's members. The selection is used for tasks such as assigning role members, adding channel members, or choosing announcement managers.
disableEffect: Users cannot select server members for these built-in QChat management flows.
